business_summary.text: Honasa Consumer is a digital-first Indian beauty and personal care company that builds and acquires brands, led by Mamaearth, and sells across own platform, e-commerce, quick commerce, modern trade and general trade.

call_points.text: Five-year agenda is high-teens revenue CAGR; FY27 expected to be better than that CAGR.
Mamaearth guided as a double-digit CAGR story over five years, with FY27 better than that.
Margin gain split: 300-350 bps mix, ~100 bps operating leverage, 50 bps seasonality, plus a one-time opex benefit.
Packaging inflation did not hit Q1 gross margin; real impact expected in Q2, offset by calibrated price hikes.
Company remains negative working capital and generated almost ₹83 Cr of cash in Q1.
Distribution inventory is under 30 days and management tracks every distributor's inventory.
Analyst pressed on channel split of e-commerce growth; management declined to give a breakdown.
Analyst asked if margin guidance was too conservative; management said growth-first and reinvestment may cap margins.
Fluence Pharma acquisition still in condition precedent and diligence process; nutraceuticals housed in Honasa Health subsidiary.
At least two more ₹500+ Cr brands across the portfolio by FY31
Margin bridge: 100-150 bps each from channel efficiencies, channel mix and category mix, 150-200 bps from operating leverage
Focus categories grew ~30% in FY26 and Mamaearth is back to teens growth

operating_notes.text: Arbitral Tribunal awarded the company AED 7,254,340 (₹18.88 Cr) in its dispute against RSMM General Trading LLC.
Declared dividend of ₹3 per equity share totaling ₹98 crores (~50% of FY26 PAT).
FY26 channel mix across all Honasa brands: own platform 2%, e-commerce 15%, modern trade 28%, general trade 52%, quick commerce 3%.
Relative CM2 by channel in FY26: own platform 1x, e-commerce 2x, modern trade 2.5x, general trade 3x, quick commerce 2.5x.
Honasa had 8 partitions with dominant (>10%) market share and 80+ partitions yet to enter, per the Investor Day presentation.
Focus categories contribute almost 85% of Q1FY27 mix and grew 35%+; GT secondary sales and MT offtakes grew 40%+.
The Derma Co is the second ₹1,000 Cr brand with 80% online and 20% offline sales, present in close to 50,000 general trade outlets.
BTM Ventures, acquired in January, reached ₹150 Cr ARR and has grown almost 100% since acquisition.

timeline.summary: Honasa Consumer Limited schedules Q4 FY 2026 earnings conference call for May 21, 2026, at 5:30 PM IST with **Varun Alagh**, **Ghazal Alagh**, and **Ramanpreet Sohi** participating.
Honasa won a ₹18.88 Cr arbitral award against former distributor RSM on May 14, 2026, validating its contract termination.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹657.08 Cr, net profit ₹69.44 Cr.
Honasa Consumer Limited’s **Gaurav Pandit** shared the earnings conference call audio for Q4 FY26 on May 21, 2026, via the company website.
On its 13 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, Honasa reported 32% revenue growth with 30.5% volume growth, ~₹110 Cr EBITDA and ₹90 Cr PAT, and guided to 150-200 bps FY27 margin expansion.
Honasa Consumer announced a proposed scheme of amalgamation between its wholly-owned subsidiary BBlunt and step-down subsidiary B:Blunt Spratt.
Earnings Conference Call scheduled on Friday, November 06, 2026 at 4:00 pm (IST).
